faqs.q: Sec. 102-183. - Use of water usage charges for parks and street median irrigation systems.
faqs.a:
(a)
$0.03 per 1,000 gallons for all water sold shall be allocated for the purpose of replacing
               or improving park irrigation systems.
(b)
The fees paid and collected by virtue of this section shall not be used for general
               or other governmental propriety purposes of the city and shall be used solely to pay
               for the replacement or improvement of existing parks and street medians.
(
Ord. No. 4569, § 11, eff.1-1-2017
)
